digest.component_or_area: reconciler JIRA adapter / config ownership gate
propositions: 12 ambient config reads in reconciler JIRA adapter files are flagged below the config-ownership seam as LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS and must be moved into owned resolvers in the composition root.

11 composed-config reads (JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_PROJECT, acli timeout, datacenter settings, rich_text cutover clients, wiki_render pandoc timeout) must be cut-to-seam by delegating through new owned resolvers while preserving live-per-call resolution and error handling semantics.
The REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE read in outbound_fields.py must be owned-in-place with a single # read-via: marker instead of delegating to a resolver.
Secret boundary reads (JIRA_API_TOKEN, JIRA_PAT) must remain owned and unchanged; only non-secret composition reads are in scope for seam migration.
All 12 LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS rows must be removed from scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py and check_config_ownership.py must pass with no path-glob exceptions for the 6 affected files.

Test consumers must be updated to drive env/config through the new owned resolvers while preserving all behavior regression assertions for live endpoint precedence, fail-loud error handling, timeout clamping, and ImportError degradation.
